  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq, least_squares


def calibrate_affine_stress(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, *, archive: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None = None, inlier_fraction: float = 0.001, min_span_fraction: float = 0.10) -> tuple[float, float, bool]:
    """Return gain, physical bias, and archive-used flag for one instrument.

    Use a unique maximal inlier set with positive gain and sufficient command
    span. Thresholds are fractions of characteristic stress; no gain ridge is
    used. When current slope support fails, the archive must identify a slope
    for the same instrument and that slope is held fixed. A majority of
    mutually consistent offsets can update its bias; a lone check may only
    correct a shift smaller than min_span_fraction of characteristic stress.
    """
    if not all(np.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in (stress_scale, inlier_fraction, min_span_fraction)):
        raise ValueError('stress scale, inlier tolerance and minimum span must be positive')

    def clean(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
        if a.ndim != 1 or b.shape != a.shape:
            raise ValueError('checks must be matching vectors')
        use = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
        return a[use] / stress_scale, b[use] / stress_scale

    def consensus(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        dx = x[j] - x[i]
        use = np.abs(dx) > np.sqrt(np.finfo(float).eps) * min_span_fraction
        i, j, dx = i[use], j[use], dx[use]
        if not i.size:
            return None
        gain = (y[j] - y[i]) / dx
        masks = np.abs(y[None, :] - y[i, None] - gain[:, None] * (x[None, :] - x[i, None])) <= inlier_fraction
        counts = masks.sum(axis=1)
        best = np.unique(masks[counts == counts.max()], axis=0)
        if counts.max() < 3 or len(best) != 1 or np.ptp(x[best[0]]) < min_span_fraction:
            return None
        a, b = x[best[0]], y[best[0]]
        da = a - a.mean()
        g = float(da @ (b - b.mean()) / (da @ da))
        return (g, float(b.mean() - g * a.mean())) if g > 0 else None

    x, y = clean(command, measured)
    fit = consensus(x, y) if x.size >= 4 else None
    if fit is not None:
        return fit[0], fit[1] * stress_scale, False
    prior = None if archive is None else consensus(*clean(*archive))
    if prior is None:
        raise ValueError('neither the current checks nor the archive identify a supported slope')
    g, b = prior
    if x.size:
        delta = y - g * x - b
        center = np.median(delta)
        agree = np.abs(delta - center) <= 4 * inlier_fraction
        if agree.sum() > x.size / 2 and (x.size > 1 or abs(center) < min_span_fraction):
            b += float(np.median(delta[agree]))
    return g, b * stress_scale, True


def align_reference_features(features: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Align and impute features without using response labels or shrinkage.

    Reference and feature matrices share rows; their columns may differ.
    Within a group, reference and feature values must share an affine nuisance
    transform and reference coupons must be comparable across groups. Use the
    median of usable reference-column means and population standard deviations.
    For each feature, give every observed group–stratum cell with data equal
    weight in its fill value. An entirely missing feature receives zero.
    Include evaluation rows only when their unlabeled covariates are available
    and transductive preprocessing is part of the evaluation protocol.
    """
    x, ref = np.asarray(features, float).copy(), np.asarray(reference, float)
    g, s = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not len(x) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or g.shape != (len(x),) or s.shape != g.shape:
        raise ValueError('features, references and labels must share the row axis')
    gi = np.unique(g, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    si = np.unique(s, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    for k in np.unique(gi):
        rows = gi == k
        panel = np.where(np.isfinite(ref[rows]), ref[rows], np.nan)
        use = np.isfinite(panel).sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not use.any():
            raise ValueError('group has no reference column with two finite observations')
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel[:, use], axis=0))
        spread = np.median(np.nanstd(panel[:, use], axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(spread) or spread <= 0:
            raise ValueError('group reference spread must be finite and positive')
        x[rows] = (x[rows] - center) / spread
    cell = np.unique(np.c_[gi, si], axis=0, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    finite = np.isfinite(x)
    total = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    cells = np.zeros(x.shape[1], dtype=int)
    for k in np.unique(cell):
        rows = cell == k
        count = finite[rows].sum(axis=0)
        sums = np.where(finite[rows], x[rows], 0.).sum(axis=0)
        total += np.divide(sums, count, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=count > 0)
        cells += count > 0
    fill = np.divide(total, cells, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=cells > 0)
    return np.where(finite, x, fill)


def fit_preloaded_creep(past_stress: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray, initial_memory: np.ndarray, past_durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, strain0: np.ndarray, strain_obs: np.ndarray, rate_obs: np.ndarray, critical_strain: np.ndarray, *, stress_scale: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], compliance_floor: float, conditioning_rate: np.ndarray | None = None, rank_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit and evaluate two exponential memories plus affine feature drift.

    Assumes calibrated piecewise-constant stresses, common segment durations,
    and a linear hereditary regime without yielding. Initial memory has stress
    units and columns ordered fast then slow. All times and bounds share a time
    unit. The fit uses bounded relaxation times, Cauchy loss with separate MAD
    scales for curves and rates, and no coefficient ridge. It rejects a weak
    or rank-deficient local fit. Nonfinite observations are omitted; use NaNs
    for prediction-only rows. Optional finite conditioning rates replace the
    fitted drift on selected rows after fitting; use NaNs on other rows.

    Return (ordered taus, physical coefficients, absolute curves, initial rates,
    secant compliance, first threshold-hit times). Coefficients are two branch
    compliances followed by drift intercept and feature slopes. A non-hit is
    right-censored at times[-1], shared with a hit exactly at the horizon.
    """
    past, hold, z0, dt, t, x, e0, obs, rates, critical = (np.asarray(a, float) for a in (past_stress, hold_stress, initial_memory, past_durations, times, features, strain0, strain_obs, rate_obs, critical_strain))
    lo, hi = tau_bounds
    if not (np.isfinite([lo, hi, stress_scale, compliance_floor]).all() and 0 < lo < hi and stress_scale > 0 and compliance_floor > 0 and 0 < rank_rtol < 1):
        raise ValueError('invalid physical scales, time bounds or rank tolerance')
    n = len(past)
    if (past.ndim != 2 or dt.shape != (past.shape[1],) or z0.shape != (n, 2) or any(a.shape != (n,) for a in (hold, e0, rates, critical)) or t.ndim != 1 or not t.size or obs.shape != (n, t.size) or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent history, feature or observation dimensions')
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (past, hold, z0, dt, t, x, e0, critical)) or np.any(dt < 0) or t[0] < 0 or np.any(np.diff(t) < 0) or t[-1] <= 0:
        raise ValueError('model inputs must be finite and times nonnegative and ordered with a positive horizon')
    ref_time = np.exp((np.log(lo) + np.log(hi)) / 2)
    lower, upper = np.log(np.array([lo, hi]) / ref_time)
    dt, t = dt / ref_time, t / ref_time
    p_hist, h, z0 = past / stress_scale, hold / stress_scale, z0 / stress_scale
    remaining = np.cumsum(dt[::-1])[::-1]
    end = np.r_[remaining[1:], 0.] if dt.size else dt
    duration = dt.sum()
    x = np.c_[np.ones(n), x]
    y = np.c_[obs - e0[:, None], rates * ref_time]
    valid = np.isfinite(y)
    k = x.shape[1] + 2
    if not valid[:, :-1].any() or not valid[:, -1].any() or valid.sum() < k + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient finite curve and rate observations')
    strain_scale = max(np.median(np.abs(y[:, :-1][valid[:, :-1]])), np.median(np.abs(y[:, -1][valid[:, -1]])))
    if strain_scale == 0:
        strain_scale = np.max(np.abs(y[valid]))
    if strain_scale == 0:
        raise ValueError('zero response does not identify the two memories')
    y /= strain_scale
    target = y[valid]
    scale = np.broadcast_to(np.r_[np.ones(t.size), 1.5], y.shape)[valid]

    def logs(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.array([q[0], q[0] + q[1] * (upper - q[0])])

    def design(q: np.ndarray, derivative: bool = False) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray | None]:
        tau = np.exp(logs(q))
        a, b = end[:, None] / tau, dt[:, None] / tau
        ea, eb = np.exp(-a), np.exp(-b)
        mix = ea * -np.expm1(-b)
        carry = z0 * np.exp(-duration / tau)
        gap = h[:, None] - p_hist @ mix - carry
        u = t[:, None] / tau
        f = -np.expm1(-u)
        curve = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * f[None, :, :], t[None, :, None] * x[:, None, :]), axis=2)
        A = np.concatenate((curve, np.c_[gap / tau, x][:, None, :]), axis=1)
        if not derivative:
            return A, tau, gap, None
        dg = -p_hist @ (a * mix - ea * b * eb) - carry * duration / tau
        G = dg[:, None, :] * f[None, :, :] - gap[:, None, :] * (u * np.exp(-u))[None, :, :]
        return A, tau, gap, np.concatenate((G, ((dg - gap) / tau)[:, None, :]), axis=1)

    def residual(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return (design(p[:2])[0][valid] @ p[2:] - target) / scale

    def log_jacobian(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        A, _, _, G = design(p[:2], True)
        return np.c_[G[valid] * p[2:4], A[valid]] / scale[:, None]

    def jacobian(p: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        J = log_jacobian(p)
        J[:, 0] += J[:, 1] * (1 - p[1])
        J[:, 1] *= upper - p[0]
        return J

    bounds = (np.r_[[lower, 0.], np.full(k, -np.inf)], np.r_[[upper, 1.], np.full(k, np.inf)])

    def optimize(start: np.ndarray, cutoff: float):
        return least_squares(residual, start, jac=jacobian, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', f_scale=cutoff, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=160)

    guesses = []
    grid = np.linspace(lower, upper, 9)
    z = target / scale
    for i, a in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
        for b in grid[i + 1:]:
            q = np.array([a, (b - a) / (upper - a)])
            A = design(q)[0][valid] / scale[:, None]
            w = np.ones(z.size)
            for _ in range(4):
                beta = np.linalg.lstsq(A * w[:, None], z * w, rcond=None)[0]
                r = A @ beta - z
                mad = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r)))
                w = 1 / np.hypot(1, r / (2 * max(0.001, mad)))
            guesses.append((np.mean(np.log1p((r / 0.04) ** 2)), np.r_[q, beta]))
    guesses.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    pilots = [optimize(p, 0.04) for _, p in guesses[:4]]
    pilot = min(pilots, key=lambda f: f.cost).x
    error = design(pilot[:2])[0] @ pilot[2:] - y
    sigma = []
    for block in (error[:, :-1][valid[:, :-1]], error[:, -1][valid[:, -1]]):
        sigma.append(max(1e-5, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(block - np.median(block)))))
    scale = np.broadcast_to(np.r_[np.full(t.size, sigma[0]), sigma[1]], y.shape)[valid]
    converged = [f for f in (optimize(p.x, 2.) for p in pilots) if f.success]
    if not converged:
        raise RuntimeError('robust creep fit did not converge')
    p = min(converged, key=lambda f: f.cost).x
    J = log_jacobian(p) / np.hypot(1, residual(p) / 2)[:, None]
    norms = np.linalg.norm(J, axis=0)
    if np.any(norms <= np.finfo(float).eps * norms.max()):
        raise ValueError('creep parameters have negligible sensitivity')
    sv = np.linalg.svd(J / norms, compute_uv=False)
    A, tau, gap, _ = design(p[:2])
    if sv[-1] < rank_rtol * sv[0] or np.log(tau[1] / tau[0]) < rank_rtol:
        raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')
    amp = gap * p[2:4] * strain_scale
    memory_rate = (amp / tau).sum(axis=1)
    drift = (x @ p[4:]) * strain_scale
    if conditioning_rate is not None:
        cond = np.asarray(conditioning_rate, float)
        if cond.shape != (n,):
            raise ValueError('conditioning rates must match the row axis')
        use = np.isfinite(cond)
        drift[use] = cond[use] * ref_time - memory_rate[use]
    change = (A[:, :-1, :2] @ p[2:4]) * strain_scale + drift[:, None] * t
    compliance = change[:, -1] / np.maximum(np.abs(hold), compliance_floor)

    def first_hit(threshold: float, amplitude: np.ndarray, d: float) -> float:
        if threshold <= 0:
            return 0.
        horizon = t[-1]
        r = amplitude / tau
        def level(u: float) -> float:
            return d * u - amplitude @ np.expm1(-u / tau) - threshold
        def speed(u: float) -> float:
            return d + r @ np.exp(-u / tau)
        left, right = r / tau
        breaks = [0., horizon]
        if np.sign(left) * np.sign(right) == -1:
            inflection = (np.log(abs(left)) - np.log(abs(right))) / (1 / tau[0] - 1 / tau[1])
            if 0 < inflection < horizon:
                breaks.insert(1, inflection)
        knots = [0.]
        for a, b in zip(breaks[:-1], breaks[1:]):
            sa, sb = speed(a), speed(b)
            if (sa < 0 < sb) or (sb < 0 < sa):
                knots.append(brentq(speed, a, b))
            if sb == 0 or b == horizon:
                knots.append(b)
        for a, b in zip(knots[:-1], knots[1:]):
            if level(b) >= 0:
                return brentq(level, a, b)
        return horizon

    crossing = np.array([first_hit(c, a, d) for c, a, d in zip(critical - e0, amp, drift)]) * ref_time
    coef = np.r_[p[2:4] * strain_scale / stress_scale, p[4:] * strain_scale / ref_time]
    return tau * ref_time, coef, e0[:, None] + change, (memory_rate + drift) / ref_time, compliance, crossing

  "synthetic_unit_test_code": "import numpy as np


def run_self_test():
    cmd = np.array([-2., -1., 0., 1., 2.])
    checked = 1.07 * cmd + 0.14
    glitch = checked.copy()
    glitch[2] += 8.
    narrow = np.array([0.70, 0.71, 0.72])
    spotted = 1.07 * narrow + 0.18
    spotted[-1] -= 5.
    for scale in (1., 0.01):
        gain, bias, archive_used = calibrate_affine_stress(scale * cmd, scale * glitch, 2. * scale)
        assert not archive_used
        np.testing.assert_allclose([gain, bias / scale], [1.07, 0.14], atol=1e-12)
        gain, bias, archive_used = calibrate_affine_stress(scale * narrow, scale * spotted, 2. * scale, archive=(scale * cmd, scale * checked))
        assert archive_used
        np.testing.assert_allclose([gain, bias / scale], [1.07, 0.18], atol=1e-12)
    with np.testing.assert_raises(ValueError):
        calibrate_affine_stress(narrow, spotted, 2.)

    # Three occupied cells, one absent group–stratum combination.
    group = np.array([0, 0, 0, 1, 1])
    stratum = np.array([0, 0, 1, 0, 0])
    ref = np.array([8., 12., 10., 18., 22.])[:, None]
    raw = np.r_[10 + np.sqrt(8/3) * np.array([1., 3., 8.]), 28., np.nan][:, None]
    aligned = align_reference_features(raw, ref, group, stratum)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(aligned[:, 0], [1., 3., 8., 4., 14/3])
    perm = np.array([3, 1, 4, 2, 0])
    gains = np.where(group == 0, 0.7, 3.4)[:, None]
    offsets = np.where(group == 0, 7., -9.)[:, None]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(align_reference_features((gains * raw + offsets)[perm], (gains * ref + offsets)[perm], group[perm], stratum[perm]), aligned[perm])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(52)
    n = 34
    tau = np.array([0.50, 2.50])
    beta = np.array([0.026, 0.046, 0.0026, -0.0018, 0.0014])
    past = rng.uniform(-2., 2., (n, 4))
    hold = rng.uniform(-2., 2., n)
    dt = np.array([0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.15])
    t = np.r_[0., np.geomspace(0.07, 7., 23)]
    features = rng.normal(size=(n, 2))
    e0 = rng.uniform(-0.005, 0.005, n)
    preload = rng.uniform(-2., 2., (n, 2))
    past[-3] = hold[-3] = 0.10
    preload[-3] = hold[-3] - np.array([0.04, -0.01]) / beta[:2] * np.exp(dt.sum() / tau)
    # Independent forward recurrence, rather than the fitter's closed form.
    state = preload.copy()
    for j, duration in enumerate(dt):
        decay = np.exp(-duration / tau)
        state = decay * state + (1 - decay) * past[:, j, None]
    amp = (hold[:, None] - state) * beta[:2]
    drift = beta[2] + features @ beta[3:]
    drift[-3] = -0.015
    truth = e0[:, None] + amp @ (-np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)).T + drift[:, None] * t
    rate = (amp / tau).sum(axis=1) + drift
    hit = 0.24
    critical = np.full(n, 10.)
    critical[-3] = e0[-3] - amp[-3] @ np.expm1(-hit / tau) + drift[-3] * hit
    critical[-2] = e0[-2] - 0.01
    assert truth[-3, -1] < critical[-3] and not np.any(t == hit)
    assert drift[-3] + (amp[-3] / tau) @ np.exp(-hit / tau) > 0
    obs, rate_obs = truth.copy(), rate.copy()
    obs[[1, 8, 13], [5, 10, 18]] += np.array([0.2, -0.3, 0.4])
    obs[-3:] = np.nan
    rate_obs[-3:] = np.nan
    conditioning = np.full(n, np.nan)
    conditioning[-3] = rate[-3]
    fit = fit_preloaded_creep(past, hold, preload, dt, t, features, e0, obs, rate_obs, critical, stress_scale=3., tau_bounds=(0.15, 8.), compliance_floor=0.5, conditioning_rate=conditioning)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in fit)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit[0], tau, rtol=5e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit[1], beta, rtol=5e-4, atol=1e-7)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit[2], truth, atol=3e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit[3], rate, atol=3e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit[4], (truth[:, -1] - e0) / np.maximum(np.abs(hold), 0.5), atol=6e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit[5][-3:], [hit, 0., t[-1]], atol=3e-5)

    # Stress and time are the dimensional axes of this operator; it has no
    # carrier frequency, spatial grid or reciprocal-pair representation.
    ks, kt = 0.01, 0.5
    scaled = fit_preloaded_creep(ks * past, ks * hold, ks * preload, kt * dt, kt * t, features, e0, obs, rate_obs / kt, critical, stress_scale=ks * 3., tau_bounds=(kt * 0.15, kt * 8.), compliance_floor=ks * 0.5, conditioning_rate=conditioning / kt)
    expected = (kt * fit[0], fit[1] / np.r_[ks, ks, kt, kt, kt], fit[2], fit[3] / kt, fit[4] / ks, kt * fit[5])
    for observed, target in zip(scaled, expected):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(observed, target, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8)


run_self_test()
